highlights.description: **Codex CLI session reader**: `omnidevx.SessionReader` lists Codex sessions with title, recent typed prompts, working directory, branch, and a resume command, for the OmniDevX session catalog

added.description: [omnidevx] `SessionReader` implementing `sessions.Reader`: reads the newest `state_N.sqlite` for session metadata and the rollout tail for recent typed prompts, tolerates missing optional columns, and reports `running` only when a `codex` process names the thread ID

highlights.description: **Realtime reliability fixes**: WebSocket events are no longer silently dropped under consumer backpressure, and message size is bounded to prevent OOM from malicious or buggy servers

fixed.description: [realtime] `readLoop` blocks on a full events channel instead of dropping server events (audio deltas, transcripts, function calls) when the consumer falls behind
[realtime] Bound WebSocket message size via `SetReadLimit(16MB)` to prevent unbounded memory allocation

tests.description: [realtime] Regression test verifying `readLoop` blocks and delivers all events in order under a slow consumer

highlights.description: **OmniDevX Codex CLI Collector**: new `omnidevx` package collecting developer-experience telemetry from Codex CLI local stores for the OmniDevX domain

added.description: [omnidevx] Codex CLI collector: session metadata from the SQLite threads index (model, reasoning effort, git branch/origin, session tokens; content columns never selected) and per-session events from rollout JSONL (prompts, tool calls with name attribution, patch applies, task durations, per-turn token usage)
[omnidevx] Graceful degradation: missing state database or schema drift falls back to rollout-only collection with diagnostics

tests.description: [omnidevx] Collector tests on fabricated rollout fixtures and in-test SQLite databases: session dedup, per-turn usage, tool attribution, schema-drift fallback, newest-database selection, and privacy assertions

dependencies.description: Add github.com/plexusone/omnidevx-core v0.1.0 and modernc.org/sqlite v1.54.0
